actions.action: Bottom-soak pot in sink/tub for 20-30 minutes
Slide out of pot and check roots
Trim black mushy roots if found
Trim brown, crispy or yellow leaves and dead center material
Water when top inch or two of soil is dry
Move to bright indirect light away from heaters and drafts
Repot into fresh well-draining mix in pot with drainage if root-bound or soil compacted
Let tap water sit overnight or use filtered water
Inspect leaves and stems for pests

reason: The answer identifies underwatering wilt on a peace lily as the main cause and leads with a thorough soak and drain, matching the fix that worked; the extra steps are optional or safeguarded and not harmful.
